label: undeservedfuture1
title_zh: 我们在 Tralfamadore 的牢笼

lines.en: label undeservedfuture1:
scene undeservedfuture1
: What?...
scene undeservedfuture2
: Where...
lines.zh: : 哪里……

lines.en: : Where...am I?
lines.zh: : 这里是……哪里？

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture3
: And...
lines.zh: : 还有……

lines.en: : Why are my boobs so much bigger all of a sudden?
lines.zh: : 为什么我的胸突然变得这么大？

lines.en: : It’s not just your boobs, Ayane...{i}Everything{/i} about you is bigger all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 不只是胸，Ayane……你{i}整个人{/i}一下子都变大了。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture4
: Sensei! Thank God...You’re still here. What do you mean by “everything,” though? Himawari’s door didn’t make me gain weight, did it?
lines.zh: : Sensei！谢天谢地……你还在。不过你说的「整个人」是什么意思？总不会是 Himawari 那扇门让我长胖了吧？

lines.en: : No, you’re just...
lines.zh: : 不是，你只是……

lines.en: : You look...{i}older.{/i}
lines.zh: : 你看起来……{i}长大{/i}了。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture5
: And {i}you{/i} look...
lines.zh: : 而{i}你{/i}看起来……

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture6
: ...Exactly the same.
lines.zh: : ……一模一样。

lines.en: : A little closer to eye level, sure. But frankly, I think it’s extremely unfair for only one of us to change. At least get a new outfit or something.
lines.zh: : 好吧，确实离视线平齐近了一点。但说实话，只有我们其中一个变了，这也太不公平了。你至少换身新衣服什么的吧。

lines.en: : And stop just staring at me like that. I haven’t seen myself in the mirror yet. I’m self-conscious.
lines.zh: : 还有别那样盯着我看了。我还没照过镜子呢，我会不好意思的。

lines.en: : Ayane...I think that door somehow took us to the future.
lines.zh: : Ayane……我觉得那扇门不知怎么把我们带到了未来。

lines.en: : The future? Is {i}that{/i} where we are right now? How do you know? Apart from me just looking older, that is.
lines.zh: : 未来？我们现在是在{i}未来{/i}？你怎么知道的？除了我看起来变老之外。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture7
: Well, for one, that calendar on the desk says it’s 2035. And, according to my calculations, that would mean we are suddenly fifteen years past where we were five minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 首先，桌上那本日历写的是 2035 年。而按我的计算，这意味着我们一下子到了五分钟前的十五年后。

lines.en: : Ha!
scene undeservedfuture8
: {i}Ha?{/i} What do you mean, “ha?”
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}？你「哈」什么？

lines.en: : What do you {i}think{/i} I mean, Sensei? If we’re still together fifteen years later, it obviously means I was right about you being my future husband! I won in the end!
lines.zh: : 你{i}觉得{/i}我是什么意思，Sensei？如果十五年后的我们还在一起，那显然说明我说对了——你就是我未来的丈夫！最后是我赢了！

lines.en: : Assuming this actually {i}is{/i} the end, of course. But, knowing our luck, I imagine this illusion will shatter in a matter of minutes and we’ll go back to being sad and fifteen years younger.
lines.zh: : 当然，前提是这{i}真的{/i}是结局。不过以我们的运气，我猜这幻象几分钟内就会碎掉，然后我们又变回那对悲伤的、年轻十五岁的自己。

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许吧。

lines.en: : Okay. Seriously, though? Stop staring at me like that. I haven’t gotten to know my grown-up self yet.
lines.zh: : 我说真的？别那样盯着我看了。我还没跟长大后的自己混熟呢。

lines.en: : It’s...uhh...
scene undeservedfuture9
: {i}Uhh{/i} what? What does that mean? That isn’t helping.
lines.zh: : {i}呃{/i}什么？那是什么意思？你这样一点忙都帮不上。

lines.en: : You’re, like...extremely hot.
lines.zh: : 你……怎么说呢……非常性感。

lines.en: : Okay, now it’s helping. Please continue.
lines.zh: : 好，现在帮上了。请继续。

lines.en: : {size=-4}The thoughts kind of cut off there. There’s a level of shell-shock one can expect after suddenly being thrown so far into the future and coming face-to-face with an aged-up version of a person they’ve had sex with over a thousand times.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-4}然后思路就断了。毕竟一个人被突然扔到这么远的未来，迎面撞上一个和自己上过一千多次床的人的成年版，多少会有点精神恍惚。{/size}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture10
: So...do we, like...{i}live{/i} here then? Is this our house?
lines.zh: : 那……我们……是{i}住{/i}在这儿吗？这是我们的房子？

lines.en: : I know just as much as you, Ayane. The only difference is I saw the calendar first.
lines.zh: : 我知道的跟你一样多，Ayane。唯一的差别是我先看了一眼日历。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture11
: What if it’s just...over?
lines.zh: : 如果只是……结束了呢？

lines.en: : What? What if {i}what’s{/i} over?
lines.zh: : 什么？{i}什么{/i}结束了？

lines.en: : Everything. Like, what if that door just...{i}saved{/i} us instead of delaying the apocalypse or whatever it was supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 一切。比如，万一那扇门只是……{i}救{/i}了我们，而不是像它本该做的那样推迟末日什么的？

lines.en: : I’d say that’s...a pretty anticlimactic ending to everything we’ve gone through. And that it would have been nice if that girl showed up like five years earlier.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那对我们经历的一切来说……是个相当虎头蛇尾的结局。而且那个女孩要是早个五年出现就好了。

lines.en: : Well, what do we do {i}now{/i} then?
lines.zh: : 那我们{i}现在{/i}怎么办？

lines.en: : {size=-1}Because both my nerves and my mind are going a little too crazy right now to have sex. And it seems like that’s what you want to do based on how you’re still looking at me like a vulture eyeing its next meal.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}因为我现在神经和脑子都乱得没法做爱。不过看你还像秃鹫盯下一顿饭那样盯着我，好像你想要的就是这个。{/size}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture12
: I don’t think it’s far off to confirm that’s essentially how I’m feeling as well.
lines.zh: : 我觉得确认我本质上也是这么想的，应该不算离谱。

lines.en: : My feelings are slightly more conflicted. I can’t tell yet if I like being almost the same size as you. I’m, like...{i}way{/i} tall for a Japanese girl now, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 我的心情就稍微复杂一点了。我还不知道自己喜不喜欢跟你差不多一样高。我现在……对一个日本女生来说是不是{i}太高{/i}了？

lines.en: : Yeah. But you’ve never really looked Japanese to begin with, so I still haven’t ruled out that you were just switched at birth or something.
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过你本来就不太像日本人，所以我还没排除你是出生时被抱错的可能性。

lines.en: : I’ve got to admit — and I know we’ve only been here for a couple minutes, but this is way nicer than I expected.
lines.zh: : 我得承认——我知道我们才来几分钟，但这比我预想的好太多了。

lines.en: : You’re not planning on turning into Horseface Taki and making me build another go-kart, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不会打算变成 Horseface Taki，再让我造一辆卡丁车吧？

lines.en: : Not at the moment, no. I’ll let you know if that changes, though.
lines.zh: : 暂时没有。不过有变化我会告诉你的。

lines.en: : Cool, thanks. Also, are you just going to stare at my boobs for this entire conversation? Or what?
lines.zh: : 谢啦。还有，你打算这一整段对话都盯着我的胸看吗？还是怎样？

lines.en: : They’re so big now.
lines.zh: : 它们现在好大。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture13
: Right?
lines.zh: : 对吧？

lines.en: : Not gonna lie, I’m kind of excited to check them out during my bath tonight.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我还挺期待今晚洗澡的时候好好看看它们的。

lines.en: : So we just...live here now then? Settle in? Not going to think about escaping or going back to normal at all? Just...relax and treat this like reality when it’s anything but?
lines.zh: : 那我们就……住在这儿了？安顿下来？完全不考虑逃走或者回到正常状态了？就……放松下来，把这里当现实，哪怕它根本不是？

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture14
: I don’t know yet. But don’t you think we should maybe try and {i}enjoy{/i} this if it really is the future? Who {i}knows{/i} when we might get another chance to experience such a thing?
lines.zh: : 我还不知道。但如果这真的是未来，你不觉得我们该试着{i}享受{/i}一下吗？谁{i}知道{/i}我们还能不能有第二次机会体验这种事？

lines.en: : I get what you’re saying. I just don’t think we should let ourselves get too attached since it’ll make inevitably leaving that much harder.
lines.zh: : 我懂你的意思。我只是觉得我们不该太投入，因为反正要离开，那样只会更难受。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture15
: Sensei, I know better than to let myself get attached to {i}anything{/i} at this point. Well, anything other than you at least. I’ll be fine. Don’t worry.
lines.zh: : Sensei，到了现在，我早就知道不该对{i}任何{/i}东西投入感情了。至少除了你之外。我不会有事的，别担心。

lines.en: : How about you, though? Will you feel better or worse looking at teenage Ayane again knowing that she winds up super stacked and super tall?
lines.zh: : 倒是你呢？再看到十几岁的 Ayane 时，你会觉得好受还是难受——毕竟你知道她最后会变得又高又有料？

lines.en: : Good question. I’ll let you know when I come up with an answer.
lines.zh: : 好问题。等我想到答案了就告诉你。

lines.en: : Want to do a little {i}exploring{/i} then? See what kind of future we’ve found ourselves in? Our bedroom’s pretty nice, so I’m excited to see the rest of the house.
lines.zh: : 那要不要稍微{i}逛一逛{/i}？看看我们掉进了什么样的未来？我们卧室挺不错的，所以我很期待看看房子其他地方。

lines.en: : You really won’t get attached?
lines.zh: : 你真的不会投入感情？

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture16
: Sensei, I’m {i}fine.{/i} Really. I-
lines.zh: : Sensei，我真的{i}没事{/i}。真的。我——

lines.en: : Because I know this is your dream, Ayane. And I want to indulge you, but I also worry about you.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道这是你的梦想，Ayane。我想纵着你，但我也担心你。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture17
scene undeservedfuture18
: {i}But...{/i}I guess there’s no reasonable alternative since just indefinitely staying in this room doesn’t sound feasible at all. And also because I have bad experiences with that exact thing.
lines.zh: : {i}不过……{/i}我想也没有什么合理的选择了，一直无限期待在这个房间里显然不现实。而且我在这方面有过惨痛教训。

lines.en: : We can explore, then?! What do you think we have in the fridge?! Oh! I wonder if there’s a garden we could-
lines.zh: : 那我们可以去逛了？！你觉得冰箱里会有什么？！哦！不知道有没有花园我们可以——

lines.en: : Don’t talk to me about gardening right now. I’ve had bad experiences with that too.
lines.zh: : 现在别跟我提园艺。那方面我也有惨痛教训。

lines.en: : It’s not {i}my{/i} fault you keep having so many bad experiences, you know.
lines.zh: : 你老是有这么多惨痛教训，这可不是{i}我的{/i}错啊。

lines.en: scene black
: Come on. Let’s see what the rest of this place looks like. Figure out whether or not it really is the {i}house of your dreams.{/i}
lines.zh: : 走吧。看看这地方其他地方长什么样。弄清楚它到底是不是你{i}梦想中的房子{/i}。

lines.en: : Heheh...I can already tell you it is.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……我现在就能告诉你它是。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture19
: Because the {i}house of my dreams{/i} is any house I live in with you. The rest of the details don’t matter to me in the slightest.
lines.zh: : 因为我{i}梦想中的房子{/i}，就是任何一栋我和你一起住的房子。其他细节对我来说一点都不重要。

lines.en: : It’s comforting knowing you still feel that way all the way over here in 2035. Now I don’t have to worry about your feelings for me expiring.
lines.zh: : 知道你到了 2035 年还是这么想，我就安心了。这下我不用担心你对我的感情过期了。

lines.en: : Some things never change, Sensei. My feelings for you are the prime example of that.
lines.zh: : 有些事永远不会变，Sensei。我对你的感情就是最好的例子。

lines.en: : I can tell by the fact that you’re still calling me “Sensei” despite us likely being married at this point.
lines.zh: : 从你到这会儿还叫我「Sensei」就能看出来了，尽管我们大概早就结婚了。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture20
: You’re not going to torture me about that again, are you? It was embarrassing enough as a teenager. Not being able to call you Akira as an adult would be-
lines.zh: : 你不会又要拿这个折磨我吧？十几岁的时候就已经够丢人了。要是当了大人还叫不出 Akira 的话那就——

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture21
: MMMMPH?!?!
lines.zh: : MMMMPH？！？！

lines.en: : See? You did it just fine right there. No problems at all apart from the fact that you are...also now beet-red.
lines.zh: : 看？你这不是叫得挺顺的嘛。一点问题都没有，唯一的问题是你现在……脸红得像煮熟的虾。

lines.en: : But how did...
lines.zh: : 可是怎么会……

lines.en: : It came out so easily all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 突然就这么顺口地出来了。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture22
: This is just a mildly educated guess, but...maybe it’s easier in {i}this{/i} world since that’s likely what you were already calling me here before we swapped in?
lines.zh: : 这只是个稍有根据的猜测，不过……也许在{i}这个{/i}世界里比较容易，因为在我们「换进来」之前，你在这里大概就是这么叫我的？

lines.en: : “Swapped in?” So you think this is an {i}actual{/i} future rather than one that’s just...made up?
lines.zh: : 「换进来」？所以你认为这是{i}真正{/i}的未来，而不是……编出来的？

lines.en: : I think that’s the cuter answer that will make you happier to hear and give you the motivation to keep pushing through the quagmire that is life itself.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这个答案更可爱，你听了会更开心，也能给你动力继续蹚过生活这片泥潭。

lines.en: : So you are lying for the sake of my happiness?
lines.zh: : 所以你是为了让我开心才撒谎的？

lines.en: : I am not answering that question. Again, for the sake of your happiness.
lines.zh: : 这个问题我不回答。同样，是为了让你开心。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture23
: In that case, I will just smile and go along with it for the sake of our alleged marriage. Finally, my arc as an alleged perfect housewife can begin.
lines.zh: : 既然这样，为了我们这段「疑似婚姻」，我就笑着配合到底吧。我那段「疑似完美主妇」的角色弧线终于可以开始了。

lines.en: : {size=-1}You can leave out the “alleged” part from now on. I’m not heartless enough to see this and not {i}also{/i} want to sort of just...be swallowed up by it rather than thinking of what’s on the other side of the door.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}从现在起你可以把「疑似」两个字去掉。我还没狠心到看见这一切，却不想就这么……被它吞没，而不是去琢磨门后有什么。{/size}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture24
: It’s a nice house, isn’t it? We probably do pretty well for ourselves.
lines.zh: : 房子挺不错的，对吧？我们大概过得挺不错。

lines.en: : {i}You{/i} probably do pretty well. I can’t imagine {i}I{/i} do anything at all.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}大概过得挺不错。{i}我{/i}估计自己什么都没干。

lines.en: : I hope you clean at least. I love you, but I don’t want to be the breadwinner {i}and{/i} the one who does all of the chores.
lines.zh: : 你至少得打扫卫生吧。我爱你，但我可不想既赚钱{i}又{/i}包揽所有家务。

lines.en: : I changed my mind. I want to go back to our world where Ami just does everything for me.
lines.zh: : 我改主意了。我想回我们的世界，那里 Ami 什么都替我做。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture25
: Ooh! Speaking of Ami, do you think we’re still in touch with anyone from high school in this world?
lines.zh: : 哦！说到 Ami，你觉得在这个世界里我们还跟高中时的人有联系吗？

lines.en: : As a husband, I certainly hope not. Because I love you, but you know I struggle with loyalty.
lines.zh: : 作为丈夫，我当然希望没有。因为我爱你，但你知道我不太擅长忠诚。

lines.en: : I love you too. And yes, you are a whore.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。没错，你就是个花心大萝卜。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture26
: But, unfortunately for both of us, my curiosity has been piqued and I must now find out.
lines.zh: : 但不巧的是，我们俩都倒霉——我的好奇心已经被勾起来了，现在我非查清楚不可。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : And we’re off to a bad start already because I just scrolled all the way through “A” and Ami is no longer in my contacts.
lines.zh: : 而且开局就不妙，我刚把「A」从头翻到尾，Ami 已经不在我的联系人里了。

lines.en: : That’s...sort of worrying considering how you two would be literally related if you and I were to get married. Which we apparently did since I removed the “alleged” part.
lines.zh: : 这……有点让人担心，毕竟如果我和你结婚，你们俩就真的是亲戚了。而既然我把「疑似」去掉了，显然我们确实结婚了。

lines.en: : Who are literally {i}any{/i} of these people? It’s all names I’ve never seen before.
lines.zh: : 这些人{i}到底{/i}都是谁啊？全是我从没见过的名字。

lines.en: : One just says “groomer.” Do we have a dog now or something?
lines.zh: : 有一个就写着「groomer」。我们是不是养狗了什么的？

lines.en: : I hope so because the only alternative I can think of would be a very rude but also sadly accurate nickname for your husband.
lines.zh: : 我希望是，因为另一个我能想到的可能，是给你丈夫起的一个很没礼貌但可悲地贴切的绰号。

lines.en: : Yeah, Akira, I’m not seeing any-
lines.zh: : 是啊，Akira，我没看到什么——

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture27
: Ah! Sana! Sana’s still in my phone! Sara too!
lines.zh: : 啊！Sana！我的手机里还有 Sana！Sara 也在！

lines.en: : Huh...I guess that makes sense. I wonder what she’s doing fifteen years after high school, though?
lines.zh: : 嗯……倒也说得通。不过我好奇她高中毕业十五年后在做什么？

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture28
: Well, worry no longer because I’m going to find out. Here’s hoping that I haven’t done anything in the last fifteen years to upset her.
lines.zh: : 别担心了，因为我这就去问个清楚。希望我这十五年没做过什么惹她生气的事。

lines.en: : You mean like marrying the guy she likes?
lines.zh: : 你是说比如嫁给她喜欢的那个男人？

lines.en: : It’s been a decade and a half. I doubt Sana still likes you that way. Especially if you and I are-
lines.zh: : 都过去十五年半了。我可不信 Sana 还那样喜欢你。特别是如果我和你已经——

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture29
: Hello?
: {i}S...Sana! Hi! How are you? Where are you? How’s the last decade been?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}S……Sana！嗨！你怎么样？你在哪儿？这十年过得如何？{/i}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture30
: Oh, Ayane. Hey. Does Akira not have his phone on him or something? I’ve been texting him all morning and he hasn’t answered.
lines.zh: : 哦，Ayane。嗨。Akira 是不是没带手机什么的？我给他发了一上午消息，他一条都没回。

lines.en: : {size=-5}{i}Fuck! You were right!{/i}{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-5}{i}操！你说对了！{/i}{/size}

lines.en: : {size=-5}{i}Told you.{/i}{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-5}{i}早说了。{/i}{/size}

lines.en: : Oh, are you with him right now? Then, could you tell him to check his messages? It’s about that book he recommended me a few months ago. I finally got around to reading it and-
lines.zh: : 哦，你现在跟他在一起吗？那能让他看一下消息吗？是关于几个月前他推荐给我的那本书。我终于抽空读了，然后——

lines.en: : {i}Forget the book! As my best friend, can I ask you to do something no questions asked? It’s really important.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}别管书了！作为我最好的朋友，我能拜托你一件事，什么都别问吗？真的很重要。{/i}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture31
: I mean...sure. But the {i}last{/i} time you asked me to have a threesome, you told me I was being way too clingy with Akira and that I couldn’t just-
lines.zh: : 呃……行吧。不过{i}上一次{/i}你叫我玩三人行的时候，你说我对 Akira 太黏人了，说我不能就这么——

lines.en: : {i}Ahhhhhh! Stop! No! I don’t want to hear about that! Just fill me in on the last ten to fifteen years of both of our lives!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}啊啊啊啊！住口！不！我不想听那个！你只要把我和你这十年到十五年的人生跟我讲一遍就行！{/i}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture32
: Huh? Why? I’m working. I don’t have time for a recap episode that long.
lines.zh: : 哈？为什么？我在上班。我没时间做那么长的一集回顾。

lines.en: : {i}Then please answer the following questions! Are Akira and I married? Why don’t I have Ami’s number anymore? When did my boobs get so big?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那就请回答下面几个问题！我和 Akira 结婚了吗？为什么我没有 Ami 的号码了？我的胸是什么时候变得这么大的？{/i}

lines.en: : Yes to the marriage thing. For Ami, I don’t know — but probably some personal stuff involving Akira.
lines.zh: : 结婚那个，是的。至于 Ami，我不知道——不过大概是跟 Akira 有关的私事。

lines.en: : And, uhh...I think your boobs started ballooning around the end of freshman year. But that’s also when you moved away, so I didn’t really get to keep tabs on their development and-
lines.zh: : 还有，呃……我觉得你的胸大概是在高一快结束的时候开始暴涨的。不过那也是你搬走的时候，所以我没能一直跟踪它们的发展，而且——

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture33
: {i}Moved?{/i} We {i}moved?{/i} To where?
lines.zh: : {i}搬走{/i}？我们{i}搬走{/i}了？搬到哪儿？

lines.en: : {i}To Aomori...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}搬到 Aomori……{/i}

lines.en: : Aomori?...
lines.zh: : Aomori？……

lines.en: : {i}Ayane, is something wrong? Did you, like...hit your head or something? What’s going on? You’re worrying me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Ayane，你没事吧？你是不是……撞到头了什么的？怎么了？你让我担心了。{/i}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture34
: Sana says we moved to Aomori...
lines.zh: : Sana 说我们搬到了 Aomori……

lines.en: : Aomori?...Why would we move all the way over there? And — better question — {i}how{/i} did we move all the way over there?
lines.zh: : Aomori？……我们干嘛要搬那么远？还有——更好的问题——我们是{i}怎么{/i}搬那么远的？

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture35
: Sana...is the barrier around Kumon-mi gone now? Or did we just find a way to-
lines.zh: : Sana……Kumon-mi 周围的结界现在没了吗？还是我们只是找到了办法——

lines.en: : {i}Ayane, that thing has been gone for fifteen years. They tore it down once we lost the space war.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Ayane，那东西已经消失十五年了。我们在太空战争里输了之后，他们就把它拆了。{/i}

lines.en: : Seriously? Just like that? But our lives practically revolved around that thing for years. And I {i}loved{/i} Kumon-mi. So why did I leave?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？就这么没了？可我们那些年的生活几乎全围着它转。而且我很{i}喜欢{/i} Kumon-mi。那我为什么要离开？

lines.en: : {i}Akira’s still with you, isn’t he? Just ask him. It was his idea.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Akira 不是还在你身边吗？问问他不就知道了。那是他的主意。{/i}

lines.en: : He’s confused too. Both of our brains are kind of, uhh...{i}not perfect{/i} right now. Which is why I need to rely on you to just tell me everything ever. So if you know {i}anything{/i} at all...please, just-
lines.zh: : 他也糊涂着呢。我们俩的脑子现在都有点……呃……{i}不太灵光{/i}。所以我只能靠你把一切都告诉我。所以只要你知情的{i}任何事{/i}……拜托，就——

lines.en: : {i}Himawari.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Himawari。{/i}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture36
: Himawari? You know her too? How?
lines.zh: : Himawari？你也认识她？怎么会？
: {i}怎……怎么会？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Because...uhh...{/i}
: {i}She’s your daughter?...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她是你们的女儿？……{/i}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture37
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : What did I just hear?
lines.zh: : 我刚才听到了什么？

lines.en: : Sana — what did Akira just hear? What did {i}I{/i} just hear?
lines.zh: : Sana——Akira 刚才听到了什么？{i}我{/i}刚才听到了什么？

lines.en: : {i}Ugh...Ayane, I’m sorry, but we’re super busy right now. Can I just call you tonight?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}唉……Ayane，抱歉，但我们现在特别忙。我今晚再打给你好吗？{/i}

lines.en: : No. You will stay on the phone and repeat what you just told me. Over and over again until I believe it.
lines.zh: : 不行。你给我待在电话那头，把你刚才说的重复一遍。一遍又一遍，直到我相信为止。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture38
: {i}Ugh...Ayane...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}唉……Ayane……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}{size=-5}Mom! Dad! I’m home!{/size}{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}{size=-5}妈！爸！我回来了！{/size}{/i}

lines.en: : Never mind! Something came up! Bye!
lines.zh: : 没事了！这边有点事！拜拜！

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture39
: So, I know you guys are {i}all for{/i} me being {i}independent{/i} and {i}spreading my wings{/i} or whatever it is you want to call it...
lines.zh: : 那个，我知道你们一直很{i}支持{/i}我{i}独立{/i}、{i}展翅高飞{/i}，或者随便你们怎么称呼……

lines.en: : But, I’ve given it some thought, and I’ve decided that it would be in all of our best interests if I just spend the rest of my life under this roof with you guys.
lines.zh: : 但是，我想了想，觉得对大家最好的选择，就是我这辈子都待在这屋檐下跟你们一起过。

lines.en: : I’ll be dropping out tomorrow. Daddy can teach me from now on. He has nothing else to do, so I’m sure it will be mutually beneficial to both of us.
lines.zh: : 我明天就退学。以后由爸爸来教我。反正他也没别的事干，所以我相信这对我们俩是双赢。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture40
scene undeservedfuture41
: Did I accidentally interrupt “adult time” again?
lines.zh: : 我又是不小心打断「大人时间」了？

lines.en: : What...did you just call me?
lines.zh: : 你刚才……叫我什么？

lines.en: : Hm? Daddy.
lines.zh: : 嗯？爸爸啊。

lines.en: : It’s what I always call you when I want you to do something for me. And, in this case, that “thing” is furthering my education. My future is in your hands, Father.
lines.zh: : 每次我想让你帮我做事的时候都这么叫你。而这次那件「事」就是继续教育我。我的未来就掌握在你手里，父亲大人。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture42
: I apologize for the interruption. I will go into my room and put my headphones on now. You won’t even know I’m here.
lines.zh: : 抱歉打扰了。我现在就回房间戴上耳机。你们根本不会知道我在这里。

lines.en: : Himawari...
lines.zh: : Himawari……

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture43
: Whatever I’m in trouble for, he’s the one who made me do it! I was under duress, I say! I had no choice! I regret everything!
lines.zh: : 不管我惹了什么麻烦，都是他让我干的！我是被胁迫的，我说！我没有选择！我后悔死了！

lines.en: : You are...
lines.zh: : 你是……

lines.en: : {i}Our daughter...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我们的女儿……{/i}

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture44
: You’re not about to tell me I’m actually adopted, are you? Because I won’t believe it. Even if I am provided with evidence.
lines.zh: : 你不会要告诉我我其实是被领养的吧？因为我不会信的。就算你们拿出证据。

lines.en: : I have a daughter...
lines.zh: : 我有一个女儿……

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture45
: Akira and I...have a daughter...
lines.zh: : Akira 和我……有一个女儿……

lines.en: : A {i}beautiful{/i} daughter...
lines.zh: : 一个{i}漂亮{/i}的女儿……

lines.en: : Who can also...travel through time?...
lines.zh: : 而且她还能……穿越时间？……

lines.en: : I mean...
lines.zh: : 我是说……

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} pretty great. But I think you might be talking me up just a {i}little{/i} too much there, Mom.
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}挺厉害的。不过我觉得你把我说得{i}有点{/i}太夸张了，妈妈。

lines.en: : I should have known the moment I saw you...
lines.zh: : 我一看到你就该认出来的……

lines.en: : How did I not realize it?...
lines.zh: : 我怎么就没认出来呢？……

lines.en: : To be fair, you were probably so hopped up on pain meds during labor that you wouldn’t have recognized {i}yourself{/i} even if you gave birth next to a mirror.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，你生我的时候大概打了太多止痛药，就算你是在镜子旁边生的，也认不出{i}自己{/i}来。

lines.en: : What’s with this sudden burst of sentimentality, though? And why does it seem like Dad is broken now? Did Niki Nakayama just announce a comeback tour or something?
lines.zh: : 不过怎么突然这么伤感？还有爸爸怎么看起来像坏掉了一样？难道是 Niki Nakayama 刚宣布复出巡演什么的？

lines.en: : He’s probably...just in shock, Himawari...
lines.zh: : 他大概……只是吓到了，Himawari……

lines.en: : We’ve had a...very eventful day...
lines.zh: : 我们今天……经历了非常多事……

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture46
: Ugh...tell me about it. I haven’t eaten a thing since breakfast this morning and am probably going to just die if I am not fed within the next hour.
lines.zh: : 唉……可不是嘛。我从今天早饭之后一口东西都没吃，要是下一个小时内还不喂我，我大概就要死了。

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture47
: So, unless you guys want a surprise visit from CPS, I think the time has come to provide for the little girl you created via carnal sin! Sound good, Dad?
lines.zh: : 所以，除非你们想让 CPS 来个突击家访，我认为是时候供养你们靠肉欲之罪造出来的这个小女孩了！怎么样，爸爸？

lines.en: : Father dearest? Your angel is speaking to you. If you keep neglecting her like this, she might scorn you for the rest of her life and grow up with a slew of personal issues.
lines.zh: : 亲爱的父亲？你的小天使在跟你说话呢。你要是继续这么冷落她，她可能会记恨你一辈子，然后带着一堆心理问题长大。

lines.en: : You don’t want to be held responsible for that, do you?
lines.zh: : 你不会想为此负责吧？

lines.en: scene undeservedfuture48
: Is he okay, Mom? I haven’t seen him this pale since Aunt Ami gave me one of her poetry anthologies for Christmas a few years ago.
lines.zh: : 他没事吧，妈妈？我上次见他这么苍白，还是几年前 Ami 阿姨圣诞节送我一本她的诗集的时候。

lines.en: : Akira...snap out of it...
lines.zh: : Akira……快醒醒……

lines.en: : Now’s not the time to start blacking out again...
lines.zh: : 现在可不是又开始晕倒的时候……

lines.en: : Look at her...just {i}look{/i} at her. She’s {i}ours!{/i} Who {i}cares{/i} if it’s not real?! Who {i}cares{/i} if-
lines.zh: : 看看她……就{i}看看{/i}她。她是{i}我们的{/i}！{i}管它{/i}是不是真的？！{i}管它{/i}——

lines.en: scene black
: D-Dad?!
: What...uhh...ambulance! My bag! My phone is in my-
lines.zh: : 什么……呃……叫救护车！我的包！我的手机在——

lines.en: : Akira! Wake up! Don’t ruin this! Please!
lines.zh: : Akira！醒醒！别毁了这一切！求你了！

lines.en: : M-Mom! Did you just slap him?! Isn’t that a little-
lines.zh: : 妈——妈妈！你刚才打他了？！这也太——

lines.en: : HE NEEDS TO WAKE UP!
lines.zh: : 他必须醒过来！
